Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer introduced the incorrect place of death by extracting “Blackboys, East Sussex, England” from the Britannica page, likely reflecting an outdated/erroneous snapshot or conflating her country residence with her actual place of death. This conflicted with reliable consensus (e.g., Wikipedia and obituaries citing Belgravia, London) and even contradicted Britannica upon reload (Step 20 showed “London, England”). This premature, unverified extraction seeded the wrong location into the workflow and risked leading to an incorrect final answer.
